letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Each sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how blessed I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile, my daily sunrise. As we mark another day of love—today feels extra sweet, like a secret note hidden in the calendar—I fall deeper into our story. Thank you for being my heart’s home, wherever we roam.
poem:
In desert dunes or rain‑kissed streets,  
Your love’s the rhythm my heart repeats.  
Together we dance, both near and far,  
My soul’s compass—you’re my guiding star.
